note: Task and business-problem entry points. Text here is editorial guidance written for AIHubpedia (what to look for, questions to ask), not product claims. Tools are ranked live from the catalogue with the transparent search rules in discovery.php. A problem page is indexable only when at least three tools with reviewed, sourced profiles match; otherwise it is noindex.

transcribe-meetings-and-interviews.title: Transcribe meetings, calls and interviews
transcribe-meetings-and-interviews.problem: Teams lose decisions and action items because nobody has time to write good notes, and journalists, researchers and podcasters need searchable transcripts.
look_for: Accuracy on your accents, audio quality and vocabulary (test with your own recordings)
Languages supported
Whether a recording bot joins your calls and who gets notified
Export formats and where recordings and transcripts are stored
Price per seat versus per hour of audio
ask_vendors: Is audio used to train your models, and can we opt out?
Where is data stored and for how long?
What happens to a transcript if we cancel?

summarize-long-documents-and-pdfs.title: Summarise long documents and PDFs
summarize-long-documents-and-pdfs.problem: Reports, contracts and papers are too long to read in full, and you need answers with a pointer to where in the document they came from.
look_for: Whether answers cite the passage they came from
Upload size and page limits on the plan you would use
Whether documents are kept or used for training
Support for scanned documents
Team sharing
ask_vendors: Are uploaded files stored, and can they be deleted?
Which file types and sizes are supported on each plan?

research-a-topic-with-sources.title: Research a topic and keep the sources
research-a-topic-with-sources.problem: You need a quick, well-sourced overview of a market, technology or question and must be able to check every claim.
look_for: Visible, clickable citations for each claim
Ability to restrict or choose sources
How it handles topics with little reliable material
Free-tier limits on deep research
ask_vendors: How are sources selected and ranked?
Can we export answers with their citations?

draft-and-edit-business-writing.title: Draft and polish business writing
draft-and-edit-business-writing.problem: Emails, proposals and web copy take too long to write, and consistent tone and grammar are hard to keep across a team.
look_for: Style and tone controls that match your brand
Where it works (browser, Word, Google Docs, mobile)
Plagiarism and originality checks if you publish
Team style guides and admin controls
What text the vendor stores or learns from
ask_vendors: Is our text used to improve your models?
Can an admin set shared style rules?

answer-customer-questions.title: Answer customer questions faster
answer-customer-questions.problem: Support teams face repetitive questions, and customers expect quick answers outside office hours.
look_for: Can it answer only from your own help content?
Hand-over to a human with the full conversation
Languages and channels (web, email, chat apps)
Reporting on unresolved questions
Pricing per resolution versus per seat
ask_vendors: How do you prevent made-up answers?
Where are conversations stored?

automate-repetitive-work.title: Automate repetitive work
automate-repetitive-work.problem: Copying data between apps, routing requests and sending routine updates consume hours every week.
look_for: Connectors for the apps you already use
Error handling and run history
Whether non-developers can build and maintain flows
Limits on runs or tasks per plan
Human approval steps for risky actions
ask_vendors: What happens when a step fails?
Can we restrict who may connect accounts?

write-and-review-code.title: Write, explain and review code
write-and-review-code.problem: Developers want help with boilerplate, explanations, tests and reviews without leaking private code.
look_for: Supported editors and languages
Whether private code is retained or used for training
Context awareness of your repository
Licence and attribution handling for generated code
Seat pricing and usage limits
ask_vendors: Is our code used to train models?
Is there an enterprise data-protection mode?

create-images-and-graphics.title: Create images and graphics for marketing
create-images-and-graphics.problem: Small teams need on-brand visuals quickly, without a design agency for every post.
look_for: Commercial-use terms for generated images
Brand kit, fonts and template support
Editing tools beyond generation
Export formats and resolution on each plan
ask_vendors: Who owns the output and what are the commercial terms?
How do you handle people and trademarks in generated images?

plan-and-schedule-work.title: Plan your day and schedule work
plan-and-schedule-work.problem: Calendars fill with meetings and tasks pile up, so deadlines slip and focus time disappears.
look_for: Calendar and task integrations you rely on
How much control you keep over automatic scheduling
Team scheduling and time zones
Price per user
ask_vendors: Which calendars are supported and what permissions do you request?

improve-seo-content.title: Improve SEO content
improve-seo-content.problem: Content teams need to cover a topic fully, match search intent and keep pages up to date.
look_for: Where its keyword and competitor data comes from
Briefs versus automatic drafting
Integration with your CMS and analytics
Editorial review steps so published content is accurate
ask_vendors: What data sources are used for scoring?
How often is the data refreshed?
